title: Reflect team globe
description: A centred badge, two-line gradient heading, short lead and a dark button in a field of turning stars between two faint side rules; under them a big globe rises out of the section's bottom edge, its top half showing, with a hairline rim that turns once every 70s. The globe grows from half size and fades in as it enters the window.
notes: media is the globe (a dotted WebGL canvas in the original); empty, a softly lit round surface
the reveal is a CSS view timeline; browsers without one show the globe at once
